title: Indian state government capital outlay
definition: Direct capital expenditure on physical assets and infrastructure (Capital Outlay) by Indian State Governments and Union Territories with legislatures, from RBI Statement 4.

sources.title: State Finances: A Study of Budgets of 2025-26 — Statement 4: Decomposition of Gross Fiscal Deficit
